findings: Two counterexamples reproduced succeeded receipts for an unrelated API while the chosen service had exited or was a different process.

Short owned runtime paths and bounded cleanup produce a fully passing native engine run. All 71 capability tests, generation consistency and optional consumer discovery pass.

limitations: KA8 is not complete; KA9 and KA10 have not started. The frozen minimum 216-session evaluation remains unchanged.
